top_signals.title: Lula Plans $28 Billion Debt Buyout to Aid Consumers Before Vote
top_signals.summary: Brazil’s government plans to spend 15 billion reais to buy as much as 150 billion reais ($28 billion) of delinquent consumer debt from banks, part of President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva’s push to ease the financial strain on households and bolster his bid for a fourth term.

Tesla poised to scale production of heavy-duty Semi trucks with opening of Nevada factory
top_signals.summary: Elon Musk's automaker is set to open its first heavy-duty truck factory in Sparks, Nevada, as Tesla seeks to expand its reach.
